evidence_excerpts: There are two main stages involved: learning and deployment. The first stage learns the model based on training data, while the second uses the model on new unseen programs.
In the final step, the learned model is inserted into the compiler to predict the best optimisation decisions for new programs.
text: The machine-learning compiler workflow separates model learning from deployment: training data is used to learn a model, and the learned model is then inserted into the compiler to make predictions for new programs.
